camel_example: aliyun resourcecenter ExecuteMultiAccountSQLQuery --region cn-hangzhou --Scope 'rd-r4****' --Expression 'SELECT * FROM resources LIMIT 100;'
description_en: Queries resources across accounts by using SQL
description_zh: 使用SQL查询跨账号的资源
kebab_example: aliyun resourcecenter execute-multi-account-sql-query --expression 'SELECT * FROM resources LIMIT 100;' --scope 'rd-r4****' --region cn-hangzhou
name: ExecuteMultiAccountSQLQuery

parameters.help_en:
The SQL statement to be executed.

The length of the SQL statement to be executed must be less than 2,000 characters.

For more information about SQL syntax, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2539395.html
parameters.help_zh:
待执行SQL语句。

待执行SQL语句长度小于2000个字符。

关于SQL语法的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2539395.html
parameters.name: expression

parameters.help_en:
The account scope for the search. Valid values: 
Resource directory ID: searches for resources in the management account and all member accounts.
Root folder ID: searches for resources in all member accounts under the Root folder and its subfolders.
Folder ID: searches for resources in all member accounts under the specified folder.
Member ID: searches for resources in the specified member account.
Member ID/Resource group ID: searches for resources in the resource group of the specified member account.

For more information about how to obtain the resource directory ID, Root folder ID, folder ID, member ID, and resource group ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159995.html, https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159997.html, https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159997.html, https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/160016.html, and https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158855.html
parameters.help_zh:
搜索的账号范围。取值： 
资源目录ID，表示搜索管理账号和所有成员中的资源。
Root资源夹ID，表示搜索Root资源夹及子资源夹下的所有成员中的资源。
资源夹ID，表示搜索指定资源夹下所有成员中的资源。
成员ID，表示搜索指定成员中的资源。
成员ID/资源组ID，表示搜索指定成员的资源组中的资源。

关于如何获取资源目录ID、Root资源夹ID、资源夹ID、成员ID和资源组ID，请分别参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159995.html、https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159997.html、https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159997.html、https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/160016.html和https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158855.html
parameters.name: scope

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries per page.

Valid values: 1 to 1000.

Default value: 1000
parameters.help_zh:
每页的最大数据条数。

取值范围：1~1000。

默认值：1000
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The token used to query the next page of results.

If the total number of returned entries exceeds the MaxResults limit, the data is truncated. You can use NextToken to query the next page
parameters.help_zh:
查询返回结果下一页的令牌。

当返回结果数据总条数超过`MaxResults`限制，则数据会被截断，您可以使用`NextToken`查询下一页数据
parameters.name: next_token

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries per page

NextToken.description_en: The token used to query the next page of results
NextToken.description_zh: 查询返回结果下一页的令牌
